name: oidc-dev
description: Repro harness for the OIDC-login JWT-redeem race: mongo + komodo-core serving the **branch-built UI** from `/app/ui` exactly like production, the OIDC mock (`oidc-mock`) with its forward-auth `/verify` endpoint, the Caddy front (`komodo.oidctest.localhost` + `portal.oidctest.localhost`, forward_auth gate, JSON access log) and the `delay` sidecar (latency knob for `/auth/login/*`).
